apim.description: Azure API Management read-only control-plane operations via `az apim`.

export.piiNotes: OpenAPI/Swagger definitions may include example values devs put in description fields.

show.piiNotes: Schema bodies may include example values.

list.piiNotes: Named-value keys may hint at app config; values are NOT returned by list.

show-secret.piiNotes: Returns the secret value of the Named Value (API keys, connection strings, etc.).

list.piiNotes: Policy XML may embed example tokens/keys.

show.piiNotes: Policy XML may embed example tokens/keys.

monitor.description: Metrics, diagnostic settings, activity log, and Log Analytics queries via `az monitor`.

list.piiNotes: Pre-aggregated numeric time series; no payloads.
list.description: Query Azure Monitor PLATFORM metrics. REQUIRED: --resource = FULL ARM resource ID (e.g. /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/<name>), NOT just the resource name. REQUIRED: --metric = ONE valid metric name for that resource type. For APIM valid metric names are: Requests, Duration, BackendDuration, Capacity, SuccessfulRequests, FailedRequests, UnauthorizedRequests, OtherRequests, BlockedRequests, EventHubTotalEvents, EventHubSuccessfulEvents, EventHubDroppedEvents, EventHubRejectedEvents, EventHubTotalBytesSent, EventHubTotalFailedEvents, NetworkConnectivity (v2 SKUs only), WebSocketMessages. Do NOT use TotalRequests/IngressE2ELatency/SuccessE2ELatency (those are Container Apps / Front Door). If unsure, call monitor_metrics_list_definitions FIRST. Common optional flags: --interval (e.g. PT1M, PT5M, PT1H), --aggregation (Count|Average|Minimum|Maximum|Total), --offset (e.g. 1h, 1d, 7d), --start-time/--end-time (ISO 8601 UTC), --filter (dimension filter like "ApiId eq '*'"). Example: {"--resource": "/subscriptions/.../service/myapim", "--metric": "Requests", "--interval": "PT5M", "--aggregation": "Count", "--offset": "1h"}.

list-definitions.description: List all valid metric DEFINITIONS available for a given resource. Call this FIRST when you don't know the exact metric name. REQUIRED: --resource = FULL ARM resource ID. Returns each metric's name, supported aggregations, unit, and dimensions. Example: {"--resource": "/subscriptions/.../service/myapim"}.

list-namespaces.description: List metric namespaces published for a resource. Useful when a service emits metrics under a custom namespace. REQUIRED: --resource = FULL ARM resource ID.

list.description: List diagnostic settings on a resource — i.e. which logs/metrics are being routed to Log Analytics, Storage, or Event Hubs. REQUIRED: --resource = FULL ARM resource ID. Use this to discover which Log Analytics workspace (if any) is receiving an APIM's GatewayLogs before attempting a KQL query.

show.description: Show one diagnostic setting in detail. REQUIRED: --name <setting-name>, --resource = FULL ARM resource ID. The response contains workspaceId (ARM ID of the LAW receiving the data).

list.piiNotes: Returns caller UPN, email, IP and token claims for user-initiated operations.
list.description: List subscription-scope control-plane events (who/what/when changed a resource). Useful flags: --resource-group <rg>, --resource-id <ARM-id>, --resource-provider Microsoft.ApiManagement, --offset 1d (default 1h), --start-time/--end-time, --max-events 50. Returns caller identity (UPN/email/IP), operation name, status, correlationId.
List Log Analytics workspaces. Optional: --resource-group <rg>. Returns each workspace's ARM id, name, and customerId (the GUID needed by monitor_log_analytics_query_query --workspace).

show.description: Show one Log Analytics workspace. REQUIRED: --resource-group <rg>, --workspace-name <name>. Returns customerId (the GUID needed by monitor_log_analytics_query_query --workspace).

query.piiNotes: KQL can return arbitrary ingested data: APIM verbose logs (Authorization headers, JWTs, request/response bodies, URLs with PII), AppInsights traces/exceptions with whatever developers logged.
query.description: Run a KQL query against a Log Analytics workspace. REQUIRED parameters (EXACT names): --workspace <workspace-customer-id-GUID> (NOT the ARM id — get it from monitor_log_analytics_workspace_show.customerId), --analytics-query "<KQL string>". Optional: --timespan PT1H (ISO 8601 duration) to scope server-side. APIM gateway log table is ApiManagementGatewayLogs (only present if a diagnostic setting routes GatewayLogs to this workspace — verify with monitor_diagnostic_settings_list/show first). KQL rules: always project specific columns (never project *); cap rows with take/top; use summarize for aggregates. Example: {"--workspace": "a1b2c3d4-...", "--analytics-query": "ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResponseCode >= 500 | summarize Errors=count() by ApiId, OperationName, ResponseCode | top 20 by Errors"}. Treat Url/RequestHeaders/RequestBody/ResponseBody/ClientIP/customDimensions as PII — summarize, do not echo raw.
